activity.notes: Wimayuk Wandik, nicknamed 'Chief Pete' by the American survivors of the 1945 Gremlin Special crash, was a leader of the Yali village of Uwambo and advocated protecting the stranded outsiders. ATLAS uses the specific Uwambo Yali community rather than portraying him as a centralized chief of all Yali people.

sources.title: Mitchell Zuckoff, Lost in Shangri-La
sources.citation_text: The book contains a dedicated chapter 'Wimayuk Wandik, aka Chief Pete' and documents his leadership in Uwambo during the 1945 rescue episode.

sources.title: The Yali (Wimayuk Wandik) — Civilization V Customisation Wiki
sources.citation_text: The mod documentation identifies the historical source used for Wimayuk as a leader of the village of Uwambo and summarizes the 1945 encounter.
